other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Kerala
Applicant must be a student studying in State Government, Government aided, or Self Financing schools/colleges
Applicant must be studying from 7th class up to Diploma, Degree, Post‑Graduation or professional courses
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1000 for classes 7‑10, ₹1500 for Plus One & Two, and ₹2000 for higher education, each payable for 10 months.
